currentSourceDefects.title: Preserve retained recorder occurrence identity across browser-to-Node forwarding
currentSourceDefects.introductionAssessment: No diff, prior-source execution or regression-introduction claim is made. The mechanism is established in the current frozen source and contradicts the expressly retained Correction11 forwarding contract.
currentSourceDefects.trigger: A genuine setup/listener/action recorder error remains in window.__nsLifecycleRecorderError while the document remains open, and that same diagnostic is forwarded by more than one browser read. The current acceptance callback and surface cleanup provide a concrete double-read path: acceptance.spec.js:73-79 invokes evidence.collectLive in its callback finally, then surfaces.js:75-82,115-121 or172-187 invokes collectLive again before closing the same Page/context.
currentSourceDefects.consumerVisibleMechanism: Each page.evaluate/root.evaluate transports a fresh Node-side object for the retained browser envelope. Its existing obsOrder/documentId/timeOrigin are forwarded, but observation-errors.js uses only a fresh invocation-local Set of object references. The common ledger likewise deduplicates only entry.original/entry.normalized identity and WeakMap envelope identity; it has no retained browser-occurrence correlation, and materializeEnvelope does not retain obsOrder. Therefore the second exposure of the same browser recorder failure is assigned a new ledger order, a new normalized Error and a new serialization. The final error set contains a fabricated second recorder occurrence, potentially after later independent errors, even though the browser retained only one first recorder error.
fullTrace: native-observation.js:30,36-46,84-91,133-134 stores the first recorder envelope and assigns its observation witness.
observation-browser.js:8-20 forwards the retained envelope through page.evaluate; cursor/correlated/extraction readers also forward it at63-64,85-87 and149-151.
observation.js:42-58 stages the passive result and dispatches it to assertAndRecordObservationErrors.
observation-errors.js:25-40 deduplicates references only within that invocation, then dispatches to evidence.recordError.
evidence.js:101-105 delegates to the same createErrorLedger instance.
error-ledger.js:84-102 treats the second transported envelope as a new reference and appends another occurrence.
evidence.js:113-125 -> live-evidence.js:59-73 -> observation.js:42-58 is the cleanup passive-reader path.
acceptance.spec.js:73-79 and surfaces.js:75-82,115-121,172-187 call that collector twice for a retained live document.
currentSourceDefects.repairNeeded: Under later substantive authority, preserve and correlate an internal genuine browser-occurrence identity through forwarding, scoped to its actual document/timeOrigin, so re-exposing the retained recorder envelope reuses the existing normalized occurrence. Do not deduplicate unrelated actual Node Errors, generic message matches or unrelated caller/common-ledger numeric orders; do not mutate caller objects or change public signatures.
